plain.li: [favour,warm] We keep what we owe, {WRITER}, and we're glad to.
[favour,warm,theirLowtech] A debt between friends is the easiest kind to settle.
[favour,warm,theirHightech] Consider the account settled, and gladly.
[favour,warm,letter] I wrote this one myself, so you'd know we meant it.
[favour,cordial] What was owed is settled, and we're square with the colony.
[favour,cordial,theirLowtech] It is done as our ways ask, and nothing stands between us now.
[favour,cordial,theirHightech] We've marked it settled on our side.
[favour,cordial,call] Good to hear your voice, {WRITER}, and good to have this settled.
[favour,cool] We pay our debts, {WRITER}, so this one is paid.
[favour,cool,theirLowtech] It is given, and now nothing is owed between us.
[favour,cool,theirHightech] Done, and the books are closed on it.
[favour,refusal] We owe the colony, but we will not be held to this.
[favour,refusal,theirLowtech] Our leaders will not give it, whatever was owed.
[favour,refusal,theirHightech] Our council voted it down, and I can't change that.
[favour,refusal,call] I'm sorry, {WRITER}, but the answer is no.
[favourask,us] Your people owe the colony one, and I've come to ask for it.
[favourask,us] I'd like to talk about what your people owe us.
[favourask,us,theirLowtech] There's a debt between our peoples, and I'm here to call it in.
[favourask,us,theirHightech] Your people have an open account with us, and I'd like to settle it.
[favourtalk,them] I remember what your colony did for us.
[favourtalk,them] That's a fair thing to ask, given what we owe.
[favourtalk,them] I'll have to answer for my people, so let me think.
[favourtalk,us] It would mean a great deal to the colony.
[favourtalk,us] We wouldn't ask if we didn't need it.
[favouryes,them] A debt is a debt, and you'll have it.
[favouryes,them] My people pay what they owe, so consider it done.
[favouryes,them,theirLowtech] It is given, and the debt between us is settled.
[favouryes,them,theirHightech] Fine, we'll call the account settled.
[favourno,them] We owe you, but not that.
[favourno,them] My people won't agree to it, debt or no debt.
[favourno,them] Ask me for something else, because that I can't give.
